steps.content: Chief... Chief?
A familiar voice wakes you up. You find yourself surrounded by darkness, your hands and feet bound by rope.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Chief, you recognized my voice right away...
Victoria lowers her voice carefully and chuckles softly in your ear.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Hehe, don't worry, I've sent everyone away. No one will find us here.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: This is a place only Victoria knows of...
She lowers her voice and chuckles softly in your ear.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Don't worry, I've sent everyone away. No one will find us here.
The whispering voice in your ear drips with eerie pleasure, jolting you awake completely.

"Hiss—"
The girl lights an old mining lamp. Under the dim light, you finally see your surroundings clearly—
It is an underground depot full of cardboard boxes imprinted with MBCC logos. There is also a small cart that Faye uses to deliver goods.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Shh—Nightingale thought I escaped from the Bureau and took you with me. Don't let her hear us.
What did you do?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Don't be nervous, Chief. I just want to continue our unfinished business without being disturbed.

options: I don't know what you're talking about

choices.text: I don't know what you're talking about

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Did you forget? Love, shackles, imprisonment... In the interrogation room, our love was interrupted, and I lost the shackles you gave me.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I waited until my body recovered, and when Sis Nightingale let her guard down, I finally found a chance to be alone with you.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Come on, confine me like you did last time.
She edges closer to you step by step. You're tied to a chair with no way to escape.
Last time I shackled you for self-defense. It has nothing to do with your so-called "love." Stop misunderstanding!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: How could it be a misunderstanding? It felt the same way as it did with Daddy. I'm all too familiar with it.
I'm not a substitute for your father, nor can I give you the fatherly love you want.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Chief, you're still refusing...
She looks at her arms longingly, as if reminiscing the warmth that the shackles left on her.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Is it because you haven't felt my love yet, Chief? Indeed, it's unfair to give and not receive.
That's not what I meant... Victoria, calm down. You need help from a psychiatrist.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Why do you say the same thing as Sis Nightingale... Ahhh! I will prove my love to you, just give me a minute.
Ignoring your words, she brings over two packets of pills and a small box of syringes.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Come, open wide... ahhh...
Obviously you don't want to cooperate, so she forces your mouth open and shoves in a whole packet of pills.
Mmmph!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: That's it, swallow, take them into your body... just like you received my love in the interrogation room.
She holds your face reverently, as if worshiping a god of hope.
The coarse pills fill your mouth, pressing against the base of your tongue.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Can you feel it? All my care, yearning and reliance, please give me the shackles, respond to me...
By giving her the shackles, you can escape this torture, but that will undoubtedly deepen her twisted perceptions.
You try to shake your head and refuse her request, but the bitter chemical taste mixes with your saliva and flows into your throat. You spit out all the pills instinctively.
She pats you lightly on the back, as if to help soothe your nausea.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Spit it out, it's okay. I had this reaction too at first. You'll get used to it.
As she says that, she opens a container of oral solution and tries to pour it into your mouth.
You try your best to dodge. The rope digs into your joints, leaving bloody marks.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Don't make too much noise, or they'll get Sis Nightingale to come and stop me.
She looks aggrieved, as if she's the vulnerable one tied to the chair and not you.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: But if you don't take your medicine, you'll get sick. And when you're sick... you must take your shot!

Victoria's mood is fluctuating even more than when she was in the interrogation room. She immediately jumps into action for this sudden new idea from nowhere, expertly preparing you for your injection.
You have to follow doctors' instructions when taking medication or shots! If you just gorge like this, it can be fatal!
When will you realize that your actions directly led to the death of your loved one?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Death... isn't that just going to a faraway place? What are you afraid of, Chief?
That's just a white lie to stop you from being sad!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Chief, you've never experienced death. How can you be sure that you won't go to another world faraway after dying?
For a moment, you can't think of a way to respond.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: We can talk about death next time. For now, Victoria just wants to receive the shackles from you, Chief. Don't be afraid...
Not only does she misunderstand "love," she also has wrong ideas about life. If this stalemate continues, there might not be a "next time."
Just as you are thinking about how to persuade Victoria, Nightingale's voice comes from the hallway outside.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Have you searched here?
Victoria's face grows even paler. She grabs your bound hands and begs humbly.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: They're coming. There's not enough time, Chief. Put your shackles on me and give me your love, please?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: The purest, most searing and intense love that only belongs to me...
Nightingale! Victoria and I, we're in the medical depot! Hurry... mmph!
Victoria gags you with a bandage to muffle your cry for help.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Why do you want them to stop me? I've already proven my feelings for you, haven't I?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: ... Cough cough... medicine, syringes, there are many more here... I can give you anything you want! I only have one request...
Victoria almost exhausts all her physical strength to hold you down. Her already weak breaths become more and more rapid.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: The shackles... just shackle me and it'll be over!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I just want to feel Daddy's warmth again! Cough cough cough...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Quick! Over here!
Victoria struggles to breathe with the mask. She turns around to damage and seal the depot door lock with her blood crystals.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: No one... no one can disturb us anymore now!
With all your strength, you lean to one side and fall heavily on the ground with the chair.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: In here! Prepare to blast open the door!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I get it. It must be Daddy's wish.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Three...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I have to give you the most intense love to receive the shackles of love in return...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Two...
Victoria looks at you affectionately. Blood crystals sprout from her hands, aimed at your chest.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: One!
Dark red light floods the room.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Yes, that's it... the shackles... Daddy's warmth...
The shackles wrap around her layer after layer. She can no longer hurt you, and you are finally free from torture. The depot suddenly falls silent.
Fulfilled, Victoria smiles gently as she kneels on the ground and hugs the red light on her body. It is a completely different sight from the sadistic girl moments ago.
The footsteps of the guards approach. Nightingale gives the orders, and the guards ram open the depot's doors and drag her away... none of this seems to concern her.
She doesn't loosen her embrace of the shackles one bit. Even as she enters her cell, she continues to deflect all outside information and keeps muttering softly to herself.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Won't be... lonely anymore...
A mental age of less than ten years old, but with a rich history of sadomasochism... what an interesting patient. I told Iron long ago that she should have been sent to me.
Outside the cell, the woman with gold spectacles plays with the pocket watch in her hand. Nightingale is talking to her in an unfriendly manner.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chameleon, I didn't invite you here to talk nonsense.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I was just joking. How stern you are, Miss Nightingale.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief? You should be resting in your own room.
I'm fine.
You say that to Nightingale, but it's only been a few hours since the kidnapping, and the repulsive sensation in your throat hasn't completely disappeared.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Even the most outstanding psychiatrist in the DisCity is here. How could anything bad happen to the Chief?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You just hypnotized Victoria before she stabbed the Chief according to the orders. We could have saved the Chief without you.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: So Miss Nightingale is saying that you don't need my assistance in treating Victoria?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Strictly speaking, it's you, not me.
What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: You have two choices, Chief. Help me influence her subconscious or keep her asleep forever.
Chameleon smiles and shakes her head, shifting her gaze towards Nightingale.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Do you really think you have the freedom to choose? The FAC won't allow a Sinner who kidnapped and tried to assassinate the Chief to exist. They set these "infallible" options in the first place.
Nightingale doesn't need to respond for you to understand what Chameleon means. If you can't turn Victoria back into a safe fighting force, it is better to eliminate this threat altogether.

options: What do I need to do?

choices.text: What do I need to do?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Enter her dream, influence her in a positive way, and awaken her.
Victoria is the only Sinner confined in this heavily guarded cell. Her eyes are shut as if she's unaware of anything. A faint smile lingers on her lips as she murmurs to herself.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Daddy... Daddy...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Chief... Chief...
